help.en: Python-side copy (notifications / fix sentences) follows this; the board's own language is the header toggle.
help.zh: Python 侧文案（通知 / 修法句）跟随此值；看板自己的语言由顶栏切换。

help.en: Which markup drafts and reports written in your name use.
help.zh: 以你名义起草文档 / 报告时用哪种标记语言。

help.en: At most one GitHub version check per 24h (exposes only your IP + current version).
help.zh: 至多每 24h 向 GitHub 查一次最新版本号（只暴露 IP + 当前版本号）。

label.en: Check for updates automatically (at most once a day)
label.zh: 自动检查新版本（每天最多一次）

help.en: "Open in terminal" (take over a session) / development session / uninstall open a new window in this terminal. Auto = Ghostty when installed, else Terminal; a choice that is not installed falls back to the system default terminal.
help.zh: 「在终端打开」（接管会话）/ 开发会话 / 卸载 都在这个终端里新开窗口运行。自动 = 装了 Ghostty 就用 Ghostty，否则 Terminal；选了没装的会回落到系统默认终端。

help.en: Default state of the "also publish to the GitHub feedback tracker" checkbox in the feedback dialog; changing it there is remembered.
help.zh: 「提建议」弹窗里「同时公开到 GitHub 建议跟踪表」的默认勾选态；弹窗里改一次就记住。

label.zh: 提建议默认勾选「公开到 GitHub」

help.en: System notification when a card reaches In review: off / banner / banner + sound (default). Other notifications are unaffected.
help.zh: 卡片进入「待验收」时的系统通知：关 / 横幅 / 横幅+声音（默认）。其余通知不受影响。

help.en: System notifications are posted by the board app (§28); no app running = no banners. Permission status: Permissions checkup.
help.zh: 系统通知由看板 app（壳）投递（§28）；app 没开就没有系统通知。通知权限见「权限体检」。

help.en: Scans new notes in the vault's raw folder (where screen / meeting ingest lands).
help.zh: 扫描笔记库 raw 目录里的新笔记（屏幕/会议 ingest 的落点）。

help.en: Notes live here; the radar scans it for asks. Four standard subfolders inside the vault are used (and created) automatically: 1 - unprocessed (capture exports) · 2 - raw (radar scan source) · 3 - change-summary (change logs) · 4 - wiki (knowledge base). Default: ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault.
help.zh: 笔记存这里，雷达也从这里发现待办。vault 内自动使用并创建 4 个标准子目录：1 - unprocessed（截图/录音落点）· 2 - raw（雷达扫描源）· 3 - change-summary（变更日志）· 4 - wiki（知识库）。默认 ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault。

help.en: Each source = feature flag × source switch (§48); this is the switch, the flag lives under "Feature flags". The health line below shows what is actually in effect.
help.zh: 每个源 = feature flag × 源开关（§48）；这里是源开关，flag 在「Feature flags」。真正生效的状态看下方健康摘要。

help.en: Scans DMs / @mentions / self-DMs (the phone capture inlet). Credential: the Slack user token below.
help.zh: 扫描 DM / @提及 / 自发消息（手机端快速捕获入口）。凭证在下方 Slack user token。

help.en: Auto-filled when the token verifies (auth.test); rarely needs editing.
help.zh: 验证 token 通过后自动填好（auth.test）；一般不用手改。

help.en: Extra channels the radar scans; blank = DMs / @mentions / self-DMs only.
help.zh: 雷达额外扫描的频道；留空 = 只看 DM / @提及 / 自发消息。

label.zh: 监控频道（channel id，逗号分隔）

help.en: Messages from these people are mined for asks.
help.zh: 这些人发的消息按需求候选提取。

help.en: Turns "people needing you on Slack" (DMs / groups / @mentions) into proposal cards automatically. All 3 setup steps happen right here — no files to edit; outbound replies are drafts only, you always send them yourself. Changes apply immediately.
help.zh: 把「别人在 Slack 上找你的事」（DM / 群 / @提及）自动变成提案卡。3 步全在这里完成，不用改任何文件；对外只出草稿，永远你自己发。此区改动即时生效。

help.en: Reads unread inbox mail into proposal cards (read-only, never sends). Credential: the Gmail app password below.
help.zh: 读取收件箱未读邮件提炼需求卡（只读，不发信）。凭证在下方 Gmail 应用密码。

message.en: That email doesn't look right — e.g. you@gmail.com (a Google Workspace address works too)
message.zh: 邮箱格式不对——例：you@gmail.com（公司 Google Workspace 邮箱也可以）

help.en: Address used for the IMAP login; blank = whatever config.yaml says.
help.zh: IMAP 登录用的邮箱地址；留空 = 用 config.yaml 里的值。

help.en: Set = path B (blank = path A, the app password). The radar executes it directly each round (no shell). $GMAIL_RADAR_LAST_UID carries the progress marker; the command prints a JSON array to stdout: {uid (monotonic), from, subject, date, message_id, body}. A Gmail-API script or an MCP client both qualify. From the next round after saving the radar fetches mail via this command; see "Run status" below for the truth.
help.zh: 填了就走 B（留空 = A · 应用专用密码）。雷达每轮直接执行它（不走 shell），环境变量 GMAIL_RADAR_LAST_UID 带上次进度，命令在 stdout 打印一个 JSON 数组：{uid（单调递增）, from, subject, date, message_id, body}。Gmail API 脚本、MCP 客户端都可以。保存后下一轮起雷达改走这条命令抓邮件；跑没跑成看下面「运行状态」。

label.zh: 自定义抓取命令（B 路径）

help.en: Polls unread inbox mail and turns the ones needing you into proposal cards (notifications/marketing filtered out). Read-only — mail is never marked read. Everything is set up right here, no files to edit; changes apply immediately.
help.zh: 轮询收件箱里的未读邮件，需要你处理的自动变成提案卡（纯通知/营销直接过滤）。只读——邮件绝不会被标成已读。全部在这里配好，不用改任何文件；此区改动即时生效。

help.en: On by default: uploads event metadata only (names / durations / counts). Off = nothing is uploaded.
help.zh: 默认开：只上传事件元数据（事件名 / 耗时 / 计数）。关 = 完全不上传。

label.en: Product improvement (on by default; event metadata only — typed text needs the separate opt-in below)
label.zh: 参与产品改进（默认开，仅事件元数据——输入文本需在下方单独勾选）

help.en: Both Basic and Detailed send anonymous event metadata — event name, time, page/action, timing counts, random device id, app version. Switching to Basic also stops the typed-text upload below (text requires Detailed).
help.zh: 基础与详细都发送匿名事件元数据——事件名、时间、页面/动作、耗时计数、随机设备号、版本号。切到基础还会同时停掉下方的输入文本上传（文本需要详细级）。

help.en: Collects only what you personally type into this app (truncated to 500 chars, built-in key masking) — never the AI's answers, screen-recording content, emails or Slack messages. Turning this off stops recording and uploading new text (a few lines recorded before the switch-off may still upload with behavior stats); behavior stats are unaffected.
help.zh: 只收集你亲手输入进本 App 的文字（截断 500 字符，内置密钥掩码）——绝不含 AI 的回答、屏幕录制内容、邮件或 Slack 消息。关掉此开关即停止记录与上传新的文本（关前已记录、尚未上传的少量行仍会随行为统计发出），行为统计不受影响。

label.en: Upload the text I type, to know me better (off by default — checking is opting in: captures, questions, rework feedback, search terms; ≤500 chars each)
label.zh: 上传我输入的文本以更懂我（默认关，勾选即同意：快速捕获、提问、打回反馈、搜索词；每条 ≤500 字符）

help.en: Turning the top toggle off stops all uploads entirely; the local stats file is unaffected. See docs/TELEMETRY.md.
help.zh: 关掉最上方开关即完全停止全部上传；本地统计文件不受影响。详见 docs/TELEMETRY.md。

help.en: A recap card over the last 7 days of ingest (In review lane); skipped when nothing new landed.
help.zh: 近 7 天 ingest 的回顾卡（待验收列）；没有新数据时自动跳过。

label.en: Auto-generate a weekly "what you were up to" recap (default off)
label.zh: 每周自动生成「本周你都在忙什么」回顾卡（默认关）

help.en: One card summarizing approvals / review backlog, stuck tasks and debts. Default off (D19).
help.zh: 待审批 / 待验收积压 + 卡住任务 + 欠账的一张摘要卡。默认 off（D19）。

help.en: Fallback folder when a card names no target (home for paperwork / research; never your code repo by default).
help.zh: 卡片没指定落点时的兜底目录（文书 / 调研的家；绝不默认进你的代码 repo）。

help.en: claude --bg passes --dangerously-skip-permissions; off = blocked agents wait for you.
help.zh: claude --bg 带 --dangerously-skip-permissions；关 = 被挡住的 agent 会等你确认。

label.en: Run background tasks without per-action confirmations (faster, default on)
label.zh: 后台任务免确认执行（更快，默认开）

help.en: target_kind=new cards run gh repo create --private (needed for draft PRs).
help.zh: target_kind=new 的卡自动 gh repo create --private（draft PR 需要）。

label.en: Allow auto-creating private GitHub repos (default off)
label.zh: 允许自动创建 GitHub 私有仓库（默认关）

help.en: Cards below this estimate hide the cost chip. Enter a number ≥ 0, e.g. 5.
help.zh: 低于此值卡片不显示预估费用。请输入不小于 0 的数字，如 5。

help.en: Above this the card is T2: approval needs a typed confirmation. Enter a number ≥ 0, e.g. 50.
help.zh: 高于此值升 T2：批准要输入确认词。请输入不小于 0 的数字，如 50。

help.en: Unpinned cards older than this are purged; 0 = never.
help.zh: 超期且未标永久的卡硬删；0 = 永不自动清。

label.zh: auto_resume — 后台任务自动拉起

help.en: Master switches: analytics off = no behavior events are written locally; auto_deploy off = install.sh stops installing the deploy agent.
help.zh: 总开关层：关掉 analytics = 本机不再写任何行为事件；关掉 auto_deploy = install.sh 不再装自动部署 agent。

title.en: Feature flags (§16, all on by default)

help.en: Drafts Slack replies / mail in your voice (docs/VOICE.md). Generate the profile: python3 -m act.voice_gen in a terminal.
help.zh: 以你的口吻起草 Slack 回复 / 邮件（docs/VOICE.md）。档案生成：终端 python3 -m act.voice_gen。

title.zh: 语气档案（以你的口吻起草）

help.en: Changes what the AI sees (matched terms become placeholders).
help.zh: 打开会改变 AI 看到的内容（命中词替换为占位）。

label.en: Enable term-list redaction — replace term-list matches with [REDACTED] before sending prompts
label.zh: 启用词表脱敏 — 发出 prompt 前把词表词条替换成 [脱敏]

help.en: One term per line; re: prefix = regex. Relative paths resolve against the pipeline root.
help.zh: 一行一条；re: 前缀 = 正则。相对路径按管线根解析。

help.en: Masked regardless of the term-list switch.
help.zh: 无条件掩码；不依赖词表开关。

label.en: Secrets masking — built-in regexes (sk-ant-/xox*/AKIA/gh*_/PEM), always on regardless of the toggle above
label.zh: 密钥掩码 — 内置正则 (sk-ant-/xox*/AKIA/gh*_/PEM)，始终生效，不依赖词表开关

title.en: Redaction (local masking before sending to AI)
title.zh: 脱敏（发给 AI 前本地打码）

help.en: Repo opened by Fix with AI and developer sessions; blank = this checkout.
help.zh: 「让 AI 修」与开发会话打开的仓库；留空 = 当前 checkout。

message.en: A session id may only contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-) — the id you copy from claude is exactly that shape.
message.zh: 会话 ID 只能包含字母、数字和连字符（-）——从 claude 里复制的会话 ID 就是这个样子。

leading_hyphen.en: A session id may not start with a hyphen (-) — that's the shape of a command-line flag, not a session id.
leading_hyphen.zh: 会话 ID 不能以连字符（-）开头——那是命令行选项的形状，不是会话 ID。

help.en: When set the session is resumed with claude --resume; blank starts fresh.
help.zh: 填了就 claude --resume 这个会话，留空开新会话。
